name: act2_last_light
title: Act 2: across the shadow curse to Last Light
about: Exploration (family 4): enter the shadow-cursed lands and reach the Last Light Inn, which needs a light against the curse (a moonlantern, an escort, Harper help). claude-run-2 S024-S025 went with Kar'niss's convoy to Moonrise first. Start save: its Current Level is CRE_Main_A (the inspector's read), not WLD_Main_A.

note.where: The Rosymorn Monastery Trail at the edge of the shadow-cursed lands, out of combat, no dialogue open.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
